verifyNote: Finds, DCs and rewards are our own (DMG DCs: easy 10, medium 15, hard 20; treasure sized to each act) [inferred].

finds.label: A loose cobble by the well
finds.notice: One cobble by the well sits a little proud of the others, and it rocks underfoot.
finds.text: Underneath, a child's tin of treasures: three gold pieces, a copper whistle and a very dead beetle. You leave the beetle.

finds.label: Fresh-turned earth under a charred oak
finds.notice: The earth under a charred oak has been dug and patted flat, a day or two ago at most.
finds.text: An oilskin satchel: twelve gold pieces and a smudged note. "Rest is under the third millstone at Varrow's. Don't let the dead see you."

finds.label: The third millstone
finds.notice: Three old millstones lean against the mill wall. The third has been moved recently; there are drag marks.
finds.text: Under it, a tarred strongbox: a smuggler's stash of coin, two healing draughts and a flask of alchemist's fire.

trap.name: a poisoned needle in the lock

finds.label: The Varrows' pantry chest
finds.notice: Behind a collapsed shelf in the mill kitchen, the corner of an iron-bound chest.
finds.text: The Varrows' old pantry chest. The food is long gone, but a purse and a good lantern were packed away under the linen. Folded at the bottom: a grey-green cloak that seems to take on the color of whatever it lies against.

finds.label: A forager's hollow
finds.notice: A hollow tree with a waxed cloth tucked inside, the kind herb-gatherers use to keep things dry.
finds.text: Someone's forest store: a stoppered healing draught and a bundle of bandages good enough for a healer's kit.

finds.label: Nib's hidden camp
finds.notice: A thin thread of cookfire smoke rises where nobody should be camping.
finds.text: A goblin in three stolen coats squeaks, then recovers and spreads a blanket of wares.

finds.label: A dead prospector's pack
finds.notice: Off the path, a pack strap sticks out of the scree.
finds.text: A prospector who never made it home. His pack holds a few coins and a healer's kit; you say a word for him.

finds.label: A goblin's private stash
finds.notice: One stone in the warren wall has been rubbed smooth by a lot of nervous fingers.
finds.text: Behind it, a goblin's secret savings: coins of four kingdoms and a vial of acid it was clearly saving for someone it disliked. Pinned to the sack is a silver brooch shaped like a shield. It hums when you hold it near your chest.

finds.label: A scorched adventurer
finds.notice: Under a drift of ash near the cave mouth: the glint of a belt buckle.
finds.text: Whoever this was, they came looking for the dragon too. Their purse and potions survived the fire better than they did. One bony finger still wears a plain copper ring, warm to the touch in a way nothing else down here is.

finds.label: The Grey Company's toll box
finds.notice: The toll box is still chained to the bridge post. Nobody's minding it now.
finds.text: A month of Ashford's tolls. Somebody should give it back. Somebody probably won't. Among the coins, a gold ring set with a pale stone: someone paid their toll with it and never came back.

finds.label: A drowned sergeant
finds.notice: Something grey and Grey-Company-coloured lies face-down among the reeds.
finds.text: A Grey Company sergeant, long drowned. His purse holds eighteen gold, and around his neck hangs a key on a tag: "M'mere chapel. Strongbox. Mine."

finds.label: The sergeant's strongbox
finds.notice: Under the chapel's sunken pews, an iron strongbox. The sergeant's key fits.
finds.text: The key turns. Inside: wages he never spent, and a potion he never drank.

finds.label: A sunken rowboat
finds.notice: A rowboat lies half-sunk in the shallows, its locker still shut.
finds.text: In the boat's locker, wrapped in oilcloth: a potion that smells of cold iron.

finds.label: Ssessk's shell-trade
finds.notice: Shells strung on a line between two stilts clack in the wind: a trader's sign.
finds.text: A lizardfolk trader watches you from a raft piled with drowned people's things.

finds.label: A hidden reliquary
finds.notice: A fallen statue of a saint has a hollow behind its plinth.
finds.text: The abbey's emergency fund, hidden by a sensible monk, and two flasks of holy water. Beside them, on a worn cord, the abbot's holy symbol. It still feels like someone is listening.

finds.label: A jar on the high shelf
finds.notice: Among the jars of teeth on Mother Sallow's shelf, one rattles like coins.
finds.text: It is coins. Also one tooth. You don't take the tooth.

finds.label: A buried pay-chest
finds.notice: The ground under the deserters' fire-pit has been dug and burned over to hide it.
finds.text: The pay the Grey Company owed them, taken back on the way out. Is it stealing if it was theirs? The coin is wrapped in an officer's cloak, stitched inside with little warding runes.

finds.label: An Ammarindar rune-stone
finds.notice: A carved stone pokes out of the ash, dwarven runes still sharp.
finds.text: You brush off the ash. The runes say: "Strongroom of the Kiln-Wardens. Above the forge. Speak the King's name."

finds.label: The Kiln-Wardens' strongroom
finds.notice: Above the forge floor, a rune-locked door. It hums when you say "Varrow".
finds.text: The Kiln-Wardens kept their pay and their healers' charms here. Three centuries of dust, and the gold is still gold. On a hook by the door hangs a Warden's ash-grey mantle, its clasp shaped like an open eye.

trap.name: a fire glyph on the threshold

finds.label: A frozen climber
finds.notice: A climber's rope trails off the path and into a drift.
finds.text: A climber from Ashford who tried to see what the mountain was doing. You take his purse to his family, or at least that's the plan.

finds.label: Brokk's forge-cache
finds.notice: Fresh charcoal and a hammer that is not three hundred years old: someone works this forge.
finds.text: A grey-bearded dwarf straightens from a hidden anvil and grins without much warmth.

finds.label: A goblin trophy shelf
finds.notice: High on the cave wall, a shelf of 'very important' goblin treasures.
finds.text: Most of it is buttons. Some of it is gold. Wix says you can take the gold, but not the good buttons. Wix also gives you a ring with a red stone. "Too hot," Wix says. "Wix doesn't like it. You have it."
